activ-ar.title: ACTIV-AR
activ-ar.shortDescription: Production AI mobile application for workplace wellness, healthy habits, biometric tracking, and active breaks.
activ-ar.description: Lead Software Engineer at ACTIV-AR, an AI-powered corporate wellness and workplace health platform. Designed and built the cross-platform production mobile application for iOS and Android using React Native and TypeScript. Engineered a decoupled AI multi-provider integration layer leveraging Adapter and Strategy patterns, personalized biometric-driven workout programs, AI-powered nutritional image recognition, and native sensor integration (camera pose detection, Apple Health, and Google Health Connect). Managed production Docker environments and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.
keyHighlights: AI multi-provider integration layer via Adapter and Strategy design patterns
Personalized training program generation based on user biometrics and habits
Smart food recognition and nutritional analysis with computer vision & AI
Native sensor integration: Apple Health, Google Health Connect, and camera pose detection
Automated Docker CI/CD pipelines targeting Google Play and Apple App Store

turnar.title: Turnar
turnar.shortDescription: SaaS appointment scheduling and online booking platform with decoupled backend architecture and automations.
turnar.description: Technical Founder & Software Engineer at Turnar. End-to-end SaaS appointment scheduling platform built from scratch with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and TypeScript. Spearheaded the architectural migration to a decoupled Node.js API adhering to Feature-based Architecture for high maintainability and scalability. Integrated Mercado Pago for payment processing, automated WhatsApp reminders for appointments, and established an extensible modular architecture prepared for AI workflows. Managed production infrastructure, database provisioning, and monitoring.
keyHighlights: Decoupled architecture: Next.js frontend with high-concurrency Node.js API
Feature-based Architecture ensuring high cohesion and low coupling
Mercado Pago payment gateway integration for deposits and instant checkouts
Automated WhatsApp notification and appointment reminder dispatch system
Scalable cloud infrastructure on PostgreSQL with AI-ready modular core

cenumen.title: Cenumen Website
cenumen.shortDescription: Official national event website featuring online ticketing, real-time QR validation, and an interactive floor map.
cenumen.description: Full stack development of the official website for Cenumen, a prestigious numismatics institution in Argentina. Built to handle ticket sales and booth allocation for the country's premier 2025 collectors' convention. Features Mercado Pago payment gateway integration, real-time QR ticket generation & verification, interactive booth booking map for exhibitors, and administrative management tools. Responsible for end-to-end architecture, security protocols, domain configuration, and production deployment.
keyHighlights: Online ticket sales and instant accreditation with Mercado Pago
Real-time ticket generation and QR scanning verification system
Interactive floor map allowing exhibitors to choose and buy exhibition stands
Admin portal for manual bank transfer validation and attendee capacity control

ubuntu-platform.title: Ubuntu Platform
ubuntu-platform.shortDescription: Collaborative web platform connecting impact investors with sustainable eco-entrepreneurs.
ubuntu-platform.description: Web platform designed to connect impact investors with sustainable and green venture entrepreneurs. Served as Lead Frontend Developer, coordinating a team of three engineers under Scrum methodology with bi-weekly sprints. Built the UI using React and Tailwind CSS, integrating with a Java / Spring Boot REST API and optimizing media delivery with Cloudinary.
keyHighlights: Led a 3-engineer frontend team under Scrum methodology with iterative sprints
Implemented a modern, responsive user interface using React and Tailwind CSS
Integrated REST APIs developed with Java and Spring Boot
Optimized media asset delivery and transformations using Cloudinary
